optAboutP1.message: Hybrid-Analysis.com is a free malware analysis service for the community. It lets you submit files for detailed static and dynamic analysis.
optAboutP1.description: Options page UI string (store readiness A-23).

optAboutP2.message: The website uses a unique hybrid analysis technology to detect and analyse unknown threats. It is powered by the CrowdStrike Falcon Sandbox.
optAboutP2.description: Options page UI string (store readiness A-23).

optAboutP3.message: The Falcon Sandbox is a state-of-the-art malware analysis framework with a very agile architecture. It is used by SOCs, CERTs, DFIR teams, IT security forensic labs, researchers and threat intelligence providers around the world.
optAboutP3.description: Options page UI string (store readiness A-23).

optConsentHelp.message: Without this consent, no hashes, files, links or IP addresses are transmitted to external services. Only after you have given consent can attachments, links and metadata be sent for analysis to Hybrid Analysis, VirusTotal, urlscan.io, URLhaus or AbuseIPDB – depending on the privacy tier. You can revoke the consent at any time by switching this option off.
